services.name: Scenic City & History Tour
services.desc: See the Wisconsin Dells like never before! 360 views and amazing photo opportunities! 1 - 1.5 hours Your Dells Sightseeing Trolley Tour activities include: GREAT FIRST DAY ACTIVITY! Get a great layout of the area, history, food and drink recommendations (never paid, only your drivers personal recommendations)! Voted the most unique tour in the Dells 2019-2021! A fun & historic trolley ride to step back in time & see the sights and sounds that made the Dells famous! We will see the Wisconsin River, the sandstone, hidden gems, and tell you how it all started. • No, it wasn’t the For all ages • 1 - 1.5 Hours • See parts of Wisconsin Dells only the locals know!

services.name: City Express Family Tour
services.desc: 30 minutes About The shortened version of our city & history tour. A great family trolley ride for those who want to experience the ride and great family time together with younger children who may not sit for an entire 90-minute city tour. ![Description of For all ages • 30 Minutes • Great for Children

services.name: Haunted History Tour
services.desc: 1.5 Hours to 2 hours based on spiritual activity. About ENHANCE YOUR TOUR WITH THE GHOST METER OPTION AT CHECKOUT! The haunted trolley Experience will take you to the darker side of the Dells. We believe the truth can often times be more frightening than fiction and we will share these stories with you! Prepare to learn about the hidden side of the Dells and the surprising haunted history and stories they try to cover up! We visit a very haunted cemetery, discuss multiple haunted locations and tell you the frightening details. . We will look for orbs (watch out for the red orbs.) Add For All Ages • 1.5 - 2 Hours • There is more to the Dells than waterparks & Roller Coasters

services.name: Haunted Pub Crawl!
services.desc: Up to 3 hours depending on spiritual activity About: A guided haunted pub crawl you can't miss just like the spirits that haunt these spooky establishments. Cold spots by the stage, apparitions in the mirror dressed in 50's clothing, and more have all happened on this tour. Come see ghost Molly or at least drink the spirits and hear about these haunts on Dell's trolley's haunted pub crawl tour! We visit a bar that used to be an old church with plenty of activity & a brief history of the little girl that haunts this bar, stop at showboat saloon or old baraboo inn depending on day of For Ages 21+ • 3 Hours • BOOS AND BREWS. Experience two kinds of "spirits"

services.name: Bloody Mary/Mimosa Brunch Tour!
services.desc: 3.5 Hours About The Bloody Mary/ Mimosa Brunch bus Tour is the perfect weekend activity if you love day drinking and love great food (who doesn't?) Brunch is only served on Sundays. On all other days, guests are welcome to order from our regular menu. lunch is often first on this tour so plan accordingly Delicious bloody marys or Mimosas and an wonderful Brunch (sometimes we will order from menu depending on number of people and date) at the best restaurant in Wisconsin Dells! This is an ALL AGES TOUR and discounted if under 21 years old. We welcome everybody on this tour! Saturdays From Ages 21+ • 3.5 hours • Amazingly HUGE buffet & Great Drinks

services.name: Mexican Fiesta TOUR
services.desc: 4-4.5 Hours About HOTEL PICKUP & DROP OFF AVAILABLE First we feature Jose’s Mexican Restaurant for a margarita & great variety of delicious food, regarded as one of the top 10 restaurants in the state.Fajitas, tacos,quesadillas,chips,salsa,dips and more. We get a margarita or beer at each stop. Very generous portions. You are guaranteed not to go home hungry! We create the feeling of being in Mexico on this adventure! Our current list of stops as of 2/16/24. This can change weekly as we like to keep it fresh and give you the best experience. What’s Included: 1st stop: Jose’s: For Ages 21+ • 4-4.5 Hours • Food and drinks are included

services.name: Santa Holiday Trolley
services.desc: 1 - 1.5 Hours About Ho! Ho! Ho! A great family holiday tour! Dell's trolley tour departs on a fun filled holiday lights adventure with an appearance and photo opportunities with Santa clause himself so make your list and check it twice. We will travel to downtown wisconsin dells for multiple fabulous Christmas lights displays, a chance to get out and take photos, and there's an incredible tree with over 30,000 lights. We will travel to the best lights displays in the dells area and have found the best of the best! Great family Ages 2+ • 1 - 1.5 Hours • Ho, ho, ho!!! Holiday lights and Santa
